items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s one of the relatively few trumpet players that you’ve played in a two-horn situation with... Yeah, right. He was a good trumpet player.

ctx.x: Whenever I asked anybody about him they didn’t seem to know anything. I heard that she [Adora] is blind now. Apparently she was not a well woman and he devoted a lot of his life to taking care of her.
He’s one of the relatively few trumpet players that you’ve played in a two-horn situation with. You’ve done Miles of course and Kenny Wheeler. A Swedish trumpet player named Yan Allen.
Yeah, right. He was a good trumpet player.
